Narakasura.note: The asura king of Pragjyotisha, son of the earth; Krishna slew him and freed the sixteen thousand women he had imprisoned.

people.Bhagadatta: King of Pragjyotisha, son of Narakasura; a Kaurava ally who fought from the great elephant Supratika, slain by Arjuna.
people.Vajradatta: Son of Bhagadatta; king of Pragjyotisha after him.
